shortDescription: Configure console preferences on OpenManage Enterprise.

options.name: builtin_appliance_share
options.description: The external network share that the appliance must access to complete operations.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: device_health
options.description: The time after which the health of the devices must be automatically monitored and updated on the OpenManage Enterprise dashboard.

options.name: discovery_settings
options.description: The device naming to be used by the OpenManage Enterprise to identify the discovered iDRACs and other devices.

options.name: email_sender_settings
options.description: The email address of the user who is sending an email message.

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular IP address or hostname.

options.name: metrics_collection_settings
options.description: The frequency of the PowerManager extension data maintenance and purging.

options.name: mx7000_onboarding_preferences
options.description: Alert-forwarding behavior on chassis when they are onboarded. C(all) to receive all alert. C(chassis) to receive chassis category alerts only.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: port
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular HTTPS port.

options.name: report_row_limit
options.description: The maximum number of rows that you can view on OpenManage Enterprise reports.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: trap_forwarding_format
options.description: The trap forwarding format. C(Original) to retain the trap data as is. C(Normalized) to normalize the trap data.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
